name: Funny Nurse Lavender Soy Candle (7 oz)
metaDescription: A 7 oz lavender scented soy candle with a funny nurse message. A cozy unwind gift for nurses after long shifts, for Nurses Week, Christmas, or retirement.
summary: A lavender soy candle with a funny nurse message, a cozy wind down gift for a nurse coming home after a long shift.
whyItWorks: After a 12 hour shift, many nurses want nothing more than a hot shower, comfortable clothes, and a quiet room. A lavender candle fits right into that routine. Lavender is a classic evening scent, and lighting a candle is a simple signal that the shift is over and the rest of the night belongs to them.

The funny message keeps the gift from feeling generic, and it gives the nurse a laugh every time they see it on the coffee table or bathroom counter. Soy wax is listed in the title, which many candle fans prefer. It works for a wide range of moments, from Nurses Week and Christmas to graduation and retirement, and it is easy to give to a coworker you do not know well. Pair it with a bath soak or cozy socks for a simple after shift care package.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the exact funny message, since wording varies by design.
Scent is personal, so confirm the recipient likes lavender before buying.
Candles cannot be lit in most hospitals, so this is strictly a home gift.

faq.q: Is a candle a good gift for a night shift nurse?
faq.a: Yes, a calming scent can be part of a wind down routine before daytime sleep, just remind them to blow it out before dozing off.

faq.q: Is it appropriate for a retirement gift?
faq.a: It works well as a lighthearted add on to a retirement card or a larger gift.
